content.short: Issuer of USDT, the most widely used stablecoin, and XAUt, a gold-backed token.
content.description: Tether created USDT in 2014, and it has become the most traded stablecoin, used across exchanges, OTC desks, wallets and payments on many blockchains. Each token is pegged one to one to the dollar and backed by Tether's reserves, which it reports on a transparency page. Tether also issues Tether Gold (XAUt), backed by physical gold, and backs projects across payments, energy, AI and education.
